title: Unit 4: Wildlife - Key Vocabulary & Terminology
content:
📌 1. Endangered (Adjective)
• English Definition: (Of a species) seriously at risk of extinction.
• Amharic Translation: በምድር ላይ የመጥፋት አደጋ የተጋረጠበት
• Synonyms: Threatened, At risk, Vulnerable
• Antonyms: Safe, Abundant, Thriving
• Example: All species of lemurs in Madagascar are considered endangered.

─────────────────────────────

📌 2. Vegetarian / Herbivorous (Noun / Adjective)
• English Definition: An animal or person that feeds mainly or only on plants and fruits.
• Amharic Translation: እፅዋት በሊጭ / እፅዋት ብቻ የሚመገብ
• Synonyms: Plant-eating, Herbivore
• Antonyms: Carnivorous, Meat-eating
• Example: All lemurs are vegetarians and prefer wild fruits like bananas and figs.

─────────────────────────────

📌 3. Dominant (Adjective)
• English Definition: Most important, powerful, or influential within a group.
• Amharic Translation: የበላይ / መሪ / ኃያል
• Synonyms: Governing, Leading, Commanding
• Antonyms: Submissive, Subordinate, Weak
• Example: Mountain gorillas live in small groups led by a dominant male.

─────────────────────────────

📌 4. Endemic (Adjective)
• English Definition: (Of a plant or animal) native and restricted to a certain specific place.
• Amharic Translation: በቁጥጥር ስር ያለ / በአንድ አካባቢ ብቻ የሚገኝ
• Synonyms: Native, Indigenous, Local
• Antonyms: Foreign, Widespread, Invasive
• Example: Some wild animals can only be found in specific regions and nowhere else.

─────────────────────────────

📌 5. Denotative Meaning (Noun Phrase)
• English Definition: The literal, primary, or main dictionary definition of a word.
• Amharic Translation: ቀጥተኛ / የመዝገበ ቃላት ትርጉም
• Synonyms: Literal meaning, Primary definition
• Antonyms: Connotative meaning, Figurative sense
• Example: The denotative meaning of 'snake' is a legless reptile.

─────────────────────────────

📌 6. Connotative Meaning (Noun Phrase)
• English Definition: The emotions, feelings, or associations connected to a word beyond its literal definition.
• Amharic Translation: ስሜታዊ / ህሊናዊ ትርጉም
• Synonyms: Implication, Nuance, Emotional sense
• Antonyms: Denotative meaning, Literal meaning
• Example: The word 'snake' often has a negative connotative meaning implying betrayal.

─────────────────────────────

📌 7. Co-existence (Noun)
• English Definition: The state or condition of living together peacefully in the same time or place.
• Amharic Translation: አብሮ መኖር / በሰላም አብሮ የመኖር ሁኔታ
• Synonyms: Harmony, Peace, Mutual tolerance
• Antonyms: Conflict, Hostility, Clashing
• Example: Proper measures are needed to turn human-wildlife conflict into healthy co-existence.

─────────────────────────────

📌 8. Clique (Noun)
• English Definition: A small, exclusive group of people that does not readily allow others to join.
• Amharic Translation: የተገለለ / ጠበብ ያለ የሰዎች ስብስብ
• Synonyms: Exclusive group, Faction, Ring
• Antonyms: Open community, Public
• Example: Unlike a general group, 'clique' has a negative connotation of excluding others.
